scripts.build: npm run build -w @marketplace/shared && npm run build -w @marketplace/api && npm run build -w @marketplace/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @marketplace/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @marketplace/api" "npm run dev -w @marketplace/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @marketplace/shared && npm run dev -w @marketplace/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @marketplace/shared && npm run test -w @marketplace/api && npm run test -w @marketplace/web
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @marketplace/shared && npm run test -w @marketplace/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @marketplace/shared && npm run typecheck -w @marketplace/api && npm run typecheck -w @marketplace/web
